comparison.objective: Fit a plug into a manifold port and keep it seated, versus tune and secure a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Port alignment and insertion may require force control, but not iterative collar rotation after releasing a setscrew or dynamic-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Correct plug remains in its port; numeric insertion/retention thresholds are absent. Candidate requires two compliant impact cycles and a post-lock drift test.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and retention primitives do not make port plugging equivalent to adjusting a damper's response and mechanically locking its setting.
